verdict.rationale: Luma ships its own programmatic API with Python/JS/TS SDKs and API keys, so generation can be scripted without the browser UI. It also has a versioned base with a published deprecation policy. However, nothing documents CI usage, a CLI or headless runner, and the FAQ states there is no sandbox or staging environment, so CI runs hit production with paid credits. Missing for 10: a CLI or documented CI/pipeline integration, a sandbox or test environment for CI runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated headless use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Luma API: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
